meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查 Codex 命令行工具的安装状态,找出过期、走样或损坏的配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 Codex 安装后行为异常,想确认本地环境是否需要更新或修复
copy.tagline_en: Health-check your Codex CLI install and flag stale, drifted, or broken setups
copy.fit_line_en: For you if Codex acts up after an install or update and you want your local setup audited

howto.what: 它会检查你本机的 LazyCodex 与 Codex CLI 安装,与最新源码对比,给出 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告,每条结论都附上产生它的命令输出或文件。只做诊断,不改动你的安装、配置和仓库。
howto.when: 当你要求做 doctor 或健康检查、提到 LazyCodex、omo-codex 等关键词,或 Codex 在安装、更新、改配置后表现异常时,它会接管诊断。

say.text: 帮我跑一遍 doctor,检查 LazyCodex 安装
say.note: 会同步最新源码并输出 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告

say.text: Codex 更新后就怪怪的,帮我看是哪里坏了
say.note: 会做运行时探针并按证据定位问题

say.text: 我的 Codex 版本能用 gpt-6-astra 吗?
say.note: 会核对版本下限与 models_cache.json

howto.what_en: It inspects your local LazyCodex and Codex CLI install, compares it with the latest sources, and returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL report where every verdict cites its evidence. Diagnosis only: it does not change your install, config, or repos.
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask for a doctor or health check, mention LazyCodex or omo-codex, or when Codex acts oddly after an install, update, or config change.

say_en.text: Run a doctor check on my LazyCodex install
say_en.note: Syncs the latest sources and prints a PASS/WARN/FAIL report.

say_en.text: Codex started acting oddly after an update, find what broke
say_en.note: Runs runtime probes and locates the cause with evidence.

say_en.text: Can my Codex version use gpt-6-astra?
say_en.note: Checks the version floor and models_cache.json.
